SELECT
  d.chunk_type AS 内容类型,
  COUNT(d.id) AS 文档数量
FROM documents AS d
WHERE
  d.parse_status = 'COMPLETED'
  AND d.kb_id IN (
    SELECT
      id
    FROM knowledge_bases
    WHERE
      org_id = 316 AND knowledge_bases.org_id = 316
  )
GROUP BY
  d.chunk_type
ORDER BY
  文档数量 DESC
LIMIT 500

GROUP BY
  kb.id,
  kb.name

LIMIT 500

SELECT
  COUNT(id) AS 检索调用次数
FROM retrieval_logs
WHERE
  created_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30 DAY'
  AND retrieval_logs.org_id = 316
LIMIT 500

SELECT
  strategy AS "检索策略",
  latency_ms AS "端到端耗时(毫秒)",
  query AS "用户原始查询",
  created_at AS "请求时间"
FROM retrieval_logs
WHERE
  retrieval_logs.org_id = 316
ORDER BY
  latency_ms DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(d.created_at AS DATE) AS day,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      d.parse_status = 'COMPLETED') AS cnt
  FROM documents AS d
  WHERE
    d.kb_id IN (
      SELECT
        id
      FROM knowledge_bases
      WHERE
        org_id = 316 AND knowledge_bases.org_id = 316
    )
  GROUP BY
    1
), top_day AS (
  SELECT
    day
  FROM daily
  ORDER BY
    cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  CAST(d.created_at AS DATE) AS "入库日期",
  d.kb_id AS "知识库ID",
  kb.name AS "知识库名称",
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    d.parse_status = 'COMPLETED') AS "入库文档数"
FROM documents AS d
JOIN top_day AS t
  ON CAST(d.created_at AS DATE) = t.day
LEFT JOIN knowledge_bases AS kb
  ON kb.id = d.kb_id AND kb.org_id = 316
WHERE
  d.kb_id IN (
    SELECT
      id
    FROM knowledge_bases
    WHERE
      org_id = 316 AND knowledge_bases.org_id = 316
  )
GROUP BY
  1,
  2,
  3
ORDER BY
  "入库文档数" DESC
LIMIT 500
